title.text: Consult engine — the doctor's screen as settings, not code

walk.text:
Walk board 1:
• Tap complaints; set how long and how bad on the right. The summary strip updates.
• Examination: dashed chips are copilot suggestions — one tap accepts.
• Rx: a green source means a reviewed, signed default; brown means no reviewed dose yet.
• Previous visits → Copy Rx to today: the copied line re-runs the checks.
• Switch to Teleconsult: the Rx shows the legal lists.
• The TAPS counter is the speed instrument.

why.text:
Owner's five tests on every board: accuracy, speed, auditable, compliant, dashboard UX.

Comment on any board to rule on it.
